Messages.Author: Sylvain Gogel
Messages.Body:
Hi to all
A little question about this marvelous Auspex card
Vampire A bleed Me for 2
One of my ready vampire play a TC
Vampire A say i add a conditioning
My ready vampire say i block the action.

My question is can i play TC before stating about block

if not legal i could play Telepathic Misdirection, so my prey
would have to manage a 5 pool bleed or a 3 pool bleed.

I stat that it's a pool bleed.

Am i wrong ?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

>
> Hi to all

> One of my ready vampire play a TC
> Vampire A say i add a conditioning

>

Yes.

> if not legal i could play Telepathic Misdirection, so my prey
> would have to manage a 5 pool bleed or a 3 pool bleed.

Yes.

> I stat that it's a pool bleed.
>
> Am i wrong ?

?
Reducing the bleed and choosing not to block are independent.
Normally the acting Meth would ask "do you block" before playing
Conditioning, though.
